run_ade20k_instance_json_conversion: run the script to convert ADE20K instance segmentation annotations to COCO JSON format
build_coco_annotations_from_ade20k_masks: build COCO-format annotations from ADE20K instance segmentation PNG masks for train and val splits
encode_segmentation_masks_to_rle: encode instance segmentation masks to RLE format using pycocotools for COCO annotation output
extract_bounding_boxes_from_masks: extract bounding boxes from instance segmentation masks by finding nonzero pixel coordinates
load_ade20k_category_id_mapping: load the ADE20K instance to semantic category ID mapping from a text file
